purpose: controlled model-family comparison for adults aged 60+; balanced performance priority
cross_validation: 5-fold StratifiedKFold, shuffle=True, random_state=42; identical folds for candidates
selection_metric: mean fold macro-F1; inspect fold SD and per-category precision/recall before selecting
limitations: Exploratory dataset has been used in prior experiments.
Observed NHANES dietary recalls do not establish validity for planned meals.
No causal or future-BP prediction claim.
